shortDescription: Manage tenant-console user access on F5 devices via RESTCONF/OpenApi

options.name: console_user_password
options.description: Password for the B(tenant-console) user. If specified, then tenant-console user password will be set with provided password value. The password will be changed to the specified value during the initial configuration of the B(tenant-console) user

options.name: role
options.description: Role of the tenant user to be used, value of role will be always B(tenant-console)

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the B(tenant-console) user. If C(enabled), provides the ability to access the B(tenant-console) user using SSH. If C(locked), access to tenant-console disabled.

options.name: tenant_username
options.description: Username of the B(tenant-console) to enable access. It is name of tenant created on the partition/appliance.
